title: Tool tote
description: A solid-wood tool tote with housed risers, a laminated bridle-jointed handle, and a bookmatched bottom in stopped grooves. Adjust the dimensions and joinery, or switch to an exploded or individual-part view.
notes: All dimensional parameters are in inches; the displayed bounds and STL exports are in millimetres. Defaults use an 18 × 9 inch body, 6 inch sides, 10¾ inch risers, and a 20 inch laminated handle. The bottom grooves stop within the end panels. End-panel setback is an adjustable ¾ inch assumption. Optional screw bores are off until their placement is confirmed. Use individual-part views for fabrication exports; the assembled model contains touching wooden components.
